// --- Gemini Service Class ---
export class GeminiService {
  /**
   * Helper function to safely parse JSON from AI response
   */
  private safeParseJson<T>(jsonText: string, context: string): T {
    if (!jsonText || typeof jsonText !== 'string') {
      throw new Error(`Invalid input for ${context}: expected string, got ${typeof jsonText}`);
    }

    // Clean the text first
    let cleanedText = jsonText.trim();
    
    // Remove any markdown code block formatting
    cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(/^```json\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/, '');
    cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(/^```\s*/, '').replace(/\s*```$/, '');
    
    // Try direct parsing first
    try {
      return JSON.parse(cleanedText) as T;
    } catch (directError) {
      console.log(`Direct JSON parsing failed for ${context}, trying to extract JSON...`);
      
      try {
        // Find the first opening brace and last closing brace
        const firstBrace = cleanedText.indexOf('{');
        const lastBrace = cleanedText.lastIndexOf('}');
        
        if (firstBrace === -1 || lastBrace === -1 || firstBrace >= lastBrace) {
          throw new Error('No valid JSON object boundaries found in response');
        }
        
        const extractedJson = cleanedText.substring(firstBrace, lastBrace + 1);
        
        // Try to fix common escape issues
        let fixedJson = extractedJson
          // Fix escaped quotes in strings
          .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
          // Fix escaped backslashes
          .replace(/\\\\/g, '\\')
          // Fix escaped newlines
          .replace(/\\n/g, '\\n')
          // Fix any trailing commas before closing braces/brackets
          .replace(/,(\s*[}\]])/g, '$1');
        
        return JSON.parse(fixedJson) as T;
      } catch (extractError) {
        console.error(`Failed to extract and parse ${context} JSON:`, extractError);
        console.error('Raw text that failed to parse:', cleanedText.substring(0, 500) + '...');
        
        // As a last resort, try to manually fix common JSON issues
        try {
          let lastResortJson = cleanedText
            .substring(cleanedText.indexOf('{'), cleanedText.lastIndexOf('}') + 1)
            // Remove any control characters that might cause issues
            .replace(/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/g, '')
            // Fix unescaped quotes in string values (basic attempt)
            .replace(/"([^"]*)"([^":,}\]]*)"([^"]*)":/g, '"$1\\"$2\\"$3":')
            // Fix trailing commas
            .replace(/,(\s*[}\]])/g, '$1');
            
          return JSON.parse(lastResortJson) as T;
        } catch (finalError) {
          throw new Error(`Failed to parse ${context} response: ${extractError instanceof Error ? extractError.message : String(extractError)}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Analyzes a resume to extract relevant skills and experience
   * @param resumeText The text content of the resume
   * @returns Analysis of the resume including skills and recommended test level
   */
  public async analyzeResume(resumeText: string): Promise<ResumeAnalysis> {
    console.log(`GeminiService: Starting resume analysis. Resume text length: ${resumeText.length}`);
    if (resumeText.length < 50) {
      console.warn(`GeminiService: Resume text is very short. First 100 chars: "${resumeText.substring(0, 100)}"`);
    }
    
    const prompt = `Analyze this resume text for a Software Engineer role and return ONLY a valid JSON object.
Do NOT include any explanatory text before or after the JSON object.
The JSON object must strictly follow this structure:
{
  "skills": [ {"name": "string", "level": "beginner|intermediate|advanced", "yearsOfExperience": number} ],
  "primaryLanguages": ["string", ...],
  "yearsOfExperience": "string (e.g., '5 years', 'Less than 1 year')",
  "keyProjects": ["string", ...],
  "githubUsername": "string | null",
  "overallExperience": "junior|mid|senior",
  "recommendedDifficulty": "easy|medium|hard"
}

Resume text:
---
${resumeText}
---`;

    try {
      const analysisText = await generateContentWithFallback(prompt);
      console.log('GeminiService: Raw analysis response received');

      // Parse the JSON response
      const analysis = this.safeParseJson<Omit<ResumeAnalysis, 'suggestedRepo'>>(analysisText, 'resume analysis');
      console.log('GeminiService: Parsed resume analysis:', JSON.stringify(analysis, null, 2));

      // Find relevant GitHub repository (optional)
      let suggestedRepo: string | undefined;
      try {
        suggestedRepo = await this.findRelevantRepository(
          analysis.skills.map((s) => s.name).concat(analysis.primaryLanguages),
          analysis.keyProjects
        );
      } catch (repoError) {
         console.warn('Could not find relevant repository, using fallback:', repoError);
         suggestedRepo = 'https://github.com/gothinkster/realworld'; // Fallback
      }

      return { ...analysis, suggestedRepo };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('GeminiService: Error during resume analysis:', error);
      throw new Error(`Resume analysis failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Attempts to find a relevant GitHub repository based on skills/projects.
   */
  private async findRelevantRepository(skills: string[], projects: string[]): Promise<string> {
    console.log('Attempting to find relevant repository...');
    const prompt = `Based on these technical skills and project descriptions, suggest ONE highly relevant, well-maintained open-source GitHub repository URL suitable for a learning/coding challenge.
Consider the primary languages implied by the skills. Return ONLY the single repository URL as a string, nothing else.

Skills: ${skills.join(', ')}
Projects: ${projects.join(', ')}
`;

    try {
      const repoUrl = (await generateContentWithFallback(prompt)).trim();
      
      // Basic URL validation
      if (repoUrl.startsWith('http://') || repoUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
        console.log('Suggested repository found:', repoUrl);
        return repoUrl;
      } else {
         console.warn(`Gemini returned non-URL for repository suggestion: "${repoUrl}". Using fallback.`);
         throw new Error('Invalid URL format from AI');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error finding repository via Gemini:', error);
      return 'https://github.com/gothinkster/realworld'; // Fallback
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generates a coding project from a structured Job Description.
   * @param jd The job description object
   * @returns A project template with requirements and test cases
   */
  public async generateProjectFromJd(jd: JdForProjectGen): Promise<ProjectTemplate> {
    console.log('GeminiService.generateProjectFromJd: Starting project generation for JD:', jd.title);

    const getDifficulty = () => {
      if (jd.maxExperience <= 2) return 'easy';
      if (jd.maxExperience <= 5) return 'medium';
      return 'hard';
    };

    const prompt = `
      Generate a comprehensive, real-world coding project for a technical evaluation based on the following Job Description.

      **JOB DESCRIPTION:**
      - **Job Title:** ${jd.title}
      - **Role Description:** ${jd.description}
      - **Required Languages:** ${jd.languages.join(', ')}
      - **Experience Level Required:** ${jd.minExperience} to ${jd.maxExperience} years.
      - **Project Context:** ${jd.projectContext}

      **PROJECT REQUIREMENTS:**

      **1. ALIGNMENT WITH JOB DESCRIPTION:**
      - The project's domain, complexity, and required skills must directly reflect the provided Job Description.
      - If the context is 'Build an ML model to detect vessels and clouds from satellite imagery,' the project should be exactly that, not a generic web app.

      **2. CODE STRUCTURE & ORGANIZATION:**
      - Generate a realistic project structure with 5-10 files organized into logical directories (e.g., 'src', 'tests', 'data').
      - The total codebase size should be appropriate for the experience level: ${jd.minExperience}-${jd.maxExperience} years -> Aim for 600-1200 lines of code.
      - Include necessary configuration files (e.g., 'package.json', 'requirements.txt'), a 'README.md' with setup instructions, and utility scripts.

      **3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:**
      - **Languages:** The project must primarily use the following languages: ${jd.languages.join(', ')}.
      - **Dependencies:** Include a realistic set of 2-4 external libraries or frameworks commonly used for this type of project.
      - **Functionality:** The core logic should be non-trivial and implement the main features described in the "Project Context".

      **4. TESTING & VALIDATION:**
      - Provide a comprehensive test suite with 5-10 test cases.
      - Tests should cover unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases.
      - Include a test runner configuration and instructions on how to run the tests.

      **5. CI/CD AUTOMATION WITH GITHUB ACTIONS:**
      - Generate GitHub Actions workflows that automatically run tests on every push/pull request **AND** can be triggered manually.
      - Each workflow MUST include \`workflow_dispatch\` in its \`on:\` section, e.g. \`on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]\`, so the platform can dispatch it programmatically.
      - Create workflows that check code quality, run test suites, and validate functionality.
      - Include appropriate setup steps for the chosen languages and dependencies.
      - Configure workflows to report test results and update GitHub Issues based on test outcomes.
      - Use industry-standard CI/CD practices appropriate for the tech stack.

      **6. GITHUB ISSUES FOR FEATURE TRACKING:**
      - Create 3-5 GitHub Issues that represent key features or improvements candidates should implement.
      - Each issue should map to specific test cases that validate the feature.
      - Issues should progressively increase in difficulty (easy → medium → hard).
      - Include clear acceptance criteria and implementation hints.
      - Use appropriate labels (feature, bug, enhancement, testing, etc.).

      **7. INTENTIONAL BUGS & REFACTORING OPPORTUNITIES (Subtle):**
      - Introduce 2-3 subtle bugs or areas for improvement that a candidate at the specified experience level should be able to identify and fix.
      - Examples based on experience:
        - **Junior (0-2 years):** Simple logical errors, inefficient loops, missing error handling.
        - **Mid-level (3-5 years):** Poor data structure choices, non-optimal API calls, moderate design pattern violations.
        - **Senior (5+ years):** Subtle race conditions, potential security vulnerabilities (e.g., input sanitization), minor architectural flaws that hinder scalability.
      - These should not be obvious syntax errors but rather opportunities to demonstrate deeper understanding.

      **OUTPUT FORMAT:**
      Return ONLY a valid JSON object. Do NOT include any explanatory text, code comments, or markdown formatting before or after the JSON object.
      The JSON object must strictly follow this enhanced 'ProjectTemplate' interface:
      {
        "title": "string",
        "description": "string (A summary of the generated project)",
        "difficulty": "${getDifficulty()}",
        "languages": ["${jd.languages.join('", "')}"],
        "requirements": ["string", ... (A list of tasks for the candidate)],
        "projectFiles": [
          { "path": "string (e.g., 'src/main.py')", "content": "string (The full file content)" }
        ],
        "testCases": [
          { "description": "string", "input": "string | null", "expectedOutput": "string", "category": "string (e.g., 'Unit', 'Integration', 'Edge Case')", "difficulty": "string (e.g., 'Easy', 'Medium', 'Hard')", "points": "number", "verificationMethod": "string (e.g., 'Exact Match', 'Contains', 'Regex')" }
        ],
        "githubWorkflows": [
          { "path": "string (e.g., '.github/workflows/test.yml')", "content": "string (Complete YAML workflow content)" }
        ],
        "githubIssues": [
          { "title": "string", "description": "string (Detailed description with acceptance criteria)", "labels": ["string", ...], "testCaseIds": [number, ...], "difficulty": "easy|medium|hard", "points": number }
        ]
      }
      `;

    try {
      console.log('Sending project generation prompt to Gemini for JD:', jd.title);
      const projectText = await generateContentWithFallback(prompt);
      console.log('Raw project response from Gemini received.');

      const formattedProject = this.safeParseJson<ProjectTemplate>(projectText, 'project generation from JD');
      console.log('Project parsed successfully. Title:', formattedProject.title);

      // --- Post-Generation Validation ---
      console.log('Starting post-generation validation...');
      if (!formattedProject.languages || formattedProject.languages.length === 0) {
        console.warn('Generated project missing languages array.');
      }
      if (!formattedProject.projectFiles || formattedProject.projectFiles.length < 3) {
        console.warn(`Generated project has insufficient files: ${formattedProject.projectFiles?.length || 0}`);
      }
      if (!formattedProject.testCases || formattedProject.testCases.length < 3) {
        console.warn(`Generated project has insufficient test cases: ${formattedProject.testCases?.length || 0}`);
      }
      if (!formattedProject.githubWorkflows || formattedProject.githubWorkflows.length === 0) {
        console.warn('Generated project missing GitHub workflows.');
      }
      if (!formattedProject.githubIssues || formattedProject.githubIssues.length < 3) {
        console.warn(`Generated project has insufficient GitHub issues: ${formattedProject.githubIssues?.length || 0}`);
      }

      return formattedProject;
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('GeminiService.generateProjectFromJd: Error generating project:', error);
      throw new Error(`Failed to generate project from JD: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Comprehensive LLM-based code evaluation for candidate repositories (60% scoring component)
   * This is the advanced intelligence layer that evaluates code quality, architecture, and innovation
   * @param repoData Repository information and code content
   * @param jobDescription The job description to evaluate against
   * @param testCases The test cases that should be implemented
   * @returns Detailed code evaluation with 60-point score breakdown
   */
  public async evaluateCodeRepository(repoData: {
    repoUrl: string;
    repoName: string;
    files: Array<{ path: string; content: string }>;
    commitHistory?: Array<{ sha: string; message: string; timestamp: string }>;
    cicdResults?: { passed: number; total: number; details: any };
  }, jobDescription: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    languages: string[];
    minExperience: number;
    maxExperience: number;
    projectContext: string;
  }, testCases: Array<{
    description: string;
    expectedOutput: string;
    category?: string;
    difficulty?: string;
  }>): Promise<{
    totalScore: number; // 0-60 (out of 60% component)
    breakdown: {
      codeQuality: { score: number; max: 15; feedback: string };
      architecture: { score: number; max: 15; feedback: string };
      innovation: { score: number; max: 10; feedback: string };
      bestPractices: { score: number; max: 10; feedback: string };
      performance: { score: number; max: 5; feedback: string };
      security: { score: number; max: 5; feedback: string };
    };
    overallFeedback: string;
    strengths: string[];
    improvements: string[];
    expertRecommendation: 'hire' | 'strong_consider' | 'consider' | 'pass';
  }> {
    console.log('GeminiService: Starting comprehensive code evaluation for repo:', repoData.repoName);

    // Prepare file contents for analysis
    const fileContents = repoData.files.map(file => 
      `--- FILE: ${file.path} ---\n${file.content}\n`
    ).join('\n');

    const prompt = `You are a Senior Software Engineer conducting a comprehensive code review for a ${jobDescription.title} position. 

**CANDIDATE CONTEXT:**
- Position: ${jobDescription.title}
- Required Experience: ${jobDescription.minExperience}-${jobDescription.maxExperience} years
- Required Languages: ${jobDescription.languages.join(', ')}
- Project Context: ${jobDescription.projectContext}

**REPOSITORY ANALYSIS:**
Repository: ${repoData.repoName}
URL: ${repoData.repoUrl}

**CODE FILES TO ANALYZE:**
${fileContents}

**CI/CD TEST RESULTS:**
${repoData.cicdResults ? `Passed: ${repoData.cicdResults.passed}/${repoData.cicdResults.total} tests` : 'No CI/CD results available'}

**EVALUATION CRITERIA (60 POINTS TOTAL):**

1. **Code Quality (15 points)**: Clean code, readability, documentation, naming conventions, code organization
2. **Architecture & Design (15 points)**: Project structure, design patterns, modularity, scalability considerations
3. **Innovation & Problem Solving (10 points)**: Creative solutions, additional features beyond requirements, algorithmic thinking
4. **Best Practices (10 points)**: Error handling, testing approach, version control usage, dependency management
5. **Performance (5 points)**: Efficiency, optimization, resource usage
6. **Security (5 points)**: Input validation, secure coding practices, vulnerability avoidance

**ANALYSIS REQUIREMENTS:**
- Evaluate against the experience level (${jobDescription.minExperience}-${jobDescription.maxExperience} years)
- Consider the specific role requirements and tech stack
- Provide constructive, actionable feedback
- Be fair but thorough in assessment

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this EXACT structure:
{
  "totalScore": number (0-60),
  "breakdown": {
    "codeQuality": {
      "score": number (0-15),
      "max": 15,
      "feedback": "detailed analysis of code quality aspects"
    },
    "architecture": {
      "score": number (0-15),
      "max": 15,
      "feedback": "analysis of project structure and design decisions"
    },
    "innovation": {
      "score": number (0-10),
      "max": 10,
      "feedback": "evaluation of creative problem-solving and additional features"
    },
    "bestPractices": {
      "score": number (0-10),
      "max": 10,
      "feedback": "assessment of development best practices"
    },
    "performance": {
      "score": number (0-5),
      "max": 5,
      "feedback": "evaluation of code efficiency and optimization"
    },
    "security": {
      "score": number (0-5),
      "max": 5,
      "feedback": "analysis of security considerations"
    }
  },
  "overallFeedback": "comprehensive summary of the candidate's coding abilities",
  "strengths": ["specific strength 1", "specific strength 2", "..."],
  "improvements": ["specific improvement 1", "specific improvement 2", "..."],
  "expertRecommendation": "hire|strong_consider|consider|pass"
}`;

    try {
      const evaluationText = await generateContentWithFallback(prompt);
      const evaluation = this.safeParseJson<any>(evaluationText, 'code evaluation');
      
      console.log('Code evaluation completed. Total LLM score:', evaluation.totalScore, '/60');
      return evaluation;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error in code evaluation:', error);
      throw new Error(`Code evaluation failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate a comprehensive final assessment report combining CI/CD (40%) + LLM evaluation (60%)
   * @param cicdScore Score from automated tests (0-40)
   * @param llmEvaluation LLM evaluation results (0-60)
   * @param candidateInfo Basic candidate information
   * @returns Final hybrid assessment report
   */
  public async generateFinalAssessment(
    cicdScore: number,
    llmEvaluation: any,
    candidateInfo: {
      email: string;
      suitabilityScore: number;
      position: string;
    }
  ): Promise<{
    finalScore: number; // 0-100 (40% CI/CD + 60% LLM)
    grade: 'A+' | 'A' | 'B+' | 'B' | 'C+' | 'C' | 'D' | 'F';
    recommendation: 'Strong Hire' | 'Hire' | 'Consider' | 'No Hire';
    summary: string;
    details: {
      automatedTests: { score: number; percentage: string };
      codeReview: { score: number; percentage: string };
      breakdown: any;
    };
  }> {
    console.log('GeminiService: Generating final assessment report');

    const finalScore = cicdScore + llmEvaluation.totalScore;
    
    // Determine grade based on final score
    let grade: 'A+' | 'A' | 'B+' | 'B' | 'C+' | 'C' | 'D' | 'F';
    let recommendation: 'Strong Hire' | 'Hire' | 'Consider' | 'No Hire';

    if (finalScore >= 90) {
      grade = 'A+';
      recommendation = 'Strong Hire';
    } else if (finalScore >= 85) {
      grade = 'A';
      recommendation = 'Strong Hire';
    } else if (finalScore >= 80) {
      grade = 'B+';
      recommendation = 'Hire';
    } else if (finalScore >= 75) {
      grade = 'B';
      recommendation = 'Hire';
    } else if (finalScore >= 70) {
      grade = 'C+';
      recommendation = 'Consider';
    } else if (finalScore >= 65) {
      grade = 'C';
      recommendation = 'Consider';
    } else if (finalScore >= 60) {
      grade = 'D';
      recommendation = 'No Hire';
    } else {
      grade = 'F';
      recommendation = 'No Hire';
    }

    const assessmentPrompt = `Generate a professional final assessment summary for this candidate:

**Candidate**: ${candidateInfo.email}
**Position**: ${candidateInfo.position}
**Resume Suitability**: ${candidateInfo.suitabilityScore}/10
**Final Technical Score**: ${finalScore}/100
**Grade**: ${grade}
**Recommendation**: ${recommendation}

**Score Breakdown**:
- Automated Tests (40%): ${cicdScore}/40
- Code Review (60%): ${llmEvaluation.totalScore}/60

**LLM Evaluation Details**:
${JSON.stringify(llmEvaluation.breakdown, null, 2)}

**Strengths**: ${llmEvaluation.strengths.join(', ')}
**Areas for Improvement**: ${llmEvaluation.improvements.join(', ')}

Create a professional, concise summary (2-3 paragraphs) that:
1. Highlights the candidate's technical performance
2. Notes key strengths and areas for improvement
3. Justifies the recommendation

Return only the summary text, no JSON formatting.`;

    try {
      const summaryText = await generateContentWithFallback(assessmentPrompt);
      
      return {
        finalScore,
        grade,
        recommendation,
        summary: summaryText.trim(),
        details: {
          automatedTests: { 
            score: cicdScore, 
            percentage: `${Math.round((cicdScore / 40) * 100)}%` 
          },
          codeReview: { 
            score: llmEvaluation.totalScore, 
            percentage: `${Math.round((llmEvaluation.totalScore / 60) * 100)}%` 
          },
          breakdown: llmEvaluation.breakdown
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error generating final assessment:', error);
      throw new Error(`Final assessment generation failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
    }
  }
}

### src/utils/tar.ts

import { Readable } from 'stream';

interface FileData {
  path: string;
  content: string;
}

/**
 * Extracts files from a tar stream.
 * This is a simplified parser that works with the specific format
 * returned by the Gemini API.
 */
export async function untar(stream: Readable): Promise<FileData[]> {
  const files: FileData[] = [];
  let buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
  let header: { path: string; size: number } | null = null;

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    stream.on('data', (chunk) => {
      buffer = Buffer.concat([buffer, chunk]);

      while (buffer.length > 0) {
        if (!header) {
          // Tar headers are 512 bytes
          if (buffer.length < 512) break;

          const headerBuffer = buffer.slice(0, 512);
          // Check for end-of-archive marker (two empty 512-byte blocks)
          if (headerBuffer.every(b => b === 0)) {
            buffer = buffer.slice(512);
            continue; // Skip empty blocks
          }

          const path = headerBuffer.slice(0, 100).toString('utf-8').replace(/\0/g, '');
          const sizeStr = headerBuffer.slice(124, 136).toString('utf-8').replace(/\0/g, '');
          const size = parseInt(sizeStr, 8); // Size is in octal

          if (path && !isNaN(size)) {
            header = { path, size };
            buffer = buffer.slice(512);
          } else {
            // If we can't parse a header, we might be at the end.
            break;
          }
        } else {
          const { size } = header;
          const contentEnd = Math.ceil(size / 512) * 512; // Content is padded to 512-byte blocks

          if (buffer.length < contentEnd) break;

          const content = buffer.slice(0, size).toString('utf-8');
          files.push({ path: header.path, content });

          buffer = buffer.slice(contentEnd);
          header = null;
        }
      }
    });

    stream.on('end', () => {
      if (buffer.length > 0 && header) {
        // Handle any remaining data
        const content = buffer.slice(0, header.size).toString('utf-8');
        files.push({ path: header.path, content });
      }
      resolve(files);
    });

    stream.on('error', (err) => {
      reject(err);
    });
  });
}


### src/utils/projectUtils.ts

/**
 * Utility functions for project-related operations
 */

/**
 * Safely get the primary language from a project
 * Handles both the new multi-language format and legacy single language format
 * 
 * @param project Project object that may contain languages or language property
 * @returns The primary language as a string, or empty string if none found
 */
export function getPrimaryLanguage(project: any): string {
  if (!project) return '';
  
  // If languages array exists and has items, use the first one
  if (project.languages && Array.isArray(project.languages) && project.languages.length > 0) {
    return project.languages[0];
  }
  
  // Otherwise fall back to the language field or empty string
  return project.language || '';
}

### execution-service/container_exec.py

import subprocess, os, json, tempfile, shutil
from typing import Dict

LANGUAGE_IMAGE_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {
    'python': 'bansy/python:3.12',
    'javascript': 'bansy/node:20',
    'typescript': 'bansy/node:20',
}

def run_in_container(language: str, repo_path: str, main_file: str | None = None, timeout_ms: int = 10000):
    """Run tests inside a language-specific container.

    Args:
        language: canonical language string (python, javascript, typescript …)
        repo_path: host path of the cloned repository (will be mounted read-only).
        main_file: optional path (relative to repo root) to execute.
        timeout_ms: overall timeout in milliseconds.
    Returns: dict with passed, output, error.
    """
    lang_key = language.lower().split(',')[0].strip()
    image = LANGUAGE_IMAGE_MAP.get(lang_key)
    if not image:
        return {"passed": False, "error": f"No container image mapped for language '{language}'"}

    # Build docker command
    cmd = [
        'docker', 'run', '--rm',
        '--network', 'none',             # no outbound net
        '--pids-limit', '256',
        '-m', '512m',                    # memory cap
        '-v', f'{repo_path}:/workspace:ro',
        image,
    ]
    if main_file:
        cmd.extend([main_file])

    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout_ms/1000)
        return {
            'passed': completed.returncode == 0,
            'output': completed.stdout,
            'error': completed.stderr,
        }
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {'passed': False, 'output': '', 'error': 'Execution timed out'}
    except Exception as exc:
        return {'passed': False, 'output': '', 'error': str(exc)}

@app.route('/execute', methods=['POST'])
def execute_legacy():
    data = request.get_json()
    app.logger.debug(f"Received data for /execute: {data}")

    language = data.get('language')
    code_content = data.get('code')
    stdin_input = data.get('input', '')
    test_case_data = data.get('testCase', {})
    expected_output = test_case_data.get('expectedOutput', None)

    if not language or code_content is None:
        app.logger.error("Missing language or code in /execute request")
        return jsonify({"passed": False, "error": "Language and code are required"}), 400
    
    # It's good practice to have an expectedOutput, even if it's an empty string for some tests
    if expected_output is None:
        app.logger.warn("Warning: expectedOutput not provided for test case.")
        # Decide handling: either error out or assume it should be empty for now
        # For now, let's assume it means the output should be empty if not provided.
        expected_output = ""

    # Basic security: prevent execution of arbitrary commands via language string
    # You'd have a proper mapping to actual execution commands/sandboxes
    allowed_languages = {"python", "javascript", "java", "typescript"}
    if language.lower() not in allowed_languages:
        app.logger.error(f"Unsupported language: {language}")
        return jsonify({"passed": False, "error": f"Unsupported language: {language}"}), 400

    # Create temporary files for execution
    # This is a simplified and insecure way to run code. 
    # A robust solution uses sandboxing (Docker, nsjail, etc.) like Piston does.
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False, suffix=get_suffix(language)) as tmp_code_file:
            tmp_code_file.write(code_content)
            code_file_path = tmp_code_file.name
        
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False, suffix='.txt') as tmp_input_file:
            tmp_input_file.write(stdin_input)
            input_file_path = tmp_input_file.name

        # Construct execution command (VERY SIMPLIFIED AND INSECURE)
        # This needs to be replaced with a call to a sandboxed execution engine (like Piston)
        # or a much more robust and secure subprocess management.
        cmd = []
        if language.lower() == 'python':
            cmd = ['python3', code_file_path]
        elif language.lower() == 'javascript':
            cmd = ['node', code_file_path]
        # Add other languages as needed; Java/C# etc. require compilation steps.
        else:
            # For now, just return an error for other languages as an example
            os.remove(code_file_path)
            os.remove(input_file_path)
            return jsonify({"passed": False, "error": f"Execution for {language} not yet implemented in this basic server."}), 501

        app.logger.info(f"Executing command: {' '.join(cmd)} with input from {input_file_path}")
        
        # Execute with timeout and capture output
        # IMPORTANT: This is still not fully secure. Subprocess can still be dangerous.
        # A real system uses nsjail, firecracker, or similar for strong isolation.
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdin=open(input_file_path, 'r'),
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True
        )
        
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10) # 10 second timeout

        if process.returncode == 0:
            app.logger.info(f"Execution successful. Raw stdout: '{stdout}', Raw stderr: '{stderr}'")
            
            # Normalize outputs for comparison (e.g., strip trailing newlines)
            # For JSON outputs, a more robust comparison (parsing and comparing objects) might be needed.
            normalized_stdout = stdout.strip()
            normalized_expected_output = expected_output.strip()

            app.logger.info(f"Normalized stdout: '{normalized_stdout}'")
            app.logger.info(f"Normalized expected_output: '{normalized_expected_output}'")

            passed_status = (normalized_stdout == normalized_expected_output)
            
            if passed_status:
                app.logger.info("Output matches expected output. Test PASSED.")
            else:
                app.logger.info("Output does NOT match expected output. Test FAILED.")
                app.logger.info(f"Expected: '{normalized_expected_output}' ({len(normalized_expected_output)} chars)")
                app.logger.info(f"Got:      '{normalized_stdout}' ({len(normalized_stdout)} chars)")

            return jsonify({
                "passed": passed_status, 
                "output": stdout, 
                "error": stderr,
                "debug_received_expected_output": expected_output, # What was initially received or set
                "debug_normalized_expected_output": normalized_expected_output,
                "debug_normalized_stdout": normalized_stdout
            }), 200
        else:
            app.logger.error(f"Execution failed with return code {process.returncode}. Error: {stderr}, Output: {stdout}")
            return jsonify({
                "passed": False, 
                "output": stdout, 
                "error": stderr,
                "debug_received_expected_output": expected_output, # What was initially received or set
                "debug_normalized_expected_output": expected_output.strip() if isinstance(expected_output, str) else "[expected_output was not a string]",
                "debug_normalized_stdout": stdout.strip() if isinstance(stdout, str) else "[stdout was not a string]"
            }), 200 # Return 200 so Axios doesn't throw 500

    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        app.logger.error("Execution timed out")
        return jsonify({
            "passed": False, "output": "", "error": "Execution timed out after 10 seconds",
            "debug_received_expected_output": expected_output,
            "debug_normalized_expected_output": expected_output.strip() if isinstance(expected_output, str) else "[expected_output was not a string before timeout]",
            "debug_normalized_stdout": "[timeout]"
        }), 200
    except FileNotFoundError:
        app.logger.error(f"Execution command not found (e.g., node or python). Ensure it's in PATH.")
        return jsonify({
            "passed": False, "output": "", "error": "Execution environment error: command not found.",
            "debug_received_expected_output": expected_output,
            "debug_normalized_expected_output": expected_output.strip() if isinstance(expected_output, str) else "[expected_output was not a string before FileNotFoundError]",
            "debug_normalized_stdout": "[FileNotFoundError]"
        }), 200
    except Exception as e:
        app.logger.error(f"An unexpected error occurred: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        return jsonify({
            "passed": False, "output": "", "error": f"An unexpected error occurred: {str(e)}",
            "debug_received_expected_output": data.get('testCase', {}).get('expectedOutput', 'Error fetching expectedOutput'),
            "debug_normalized_expected_output": "[Error]",
            "debug_normalized_stdout": "[Error]"
        }), 200
    finally:
        # Clean up temporary files
        if 'code_file_path' in locals() and os.path.exists(code_file_path):
            os.remove(code_file_path)
        if 'input_file_path' in locals() and os.path.exists(input_file_path):
            os.remove(input_file_path)

@app.route('/run', methods=['POST'])
def execute_container():
    data = request.get_json()
    language = data.get('language')
    repo_url = data.get('repoUrl')
    main_file = data.get('mainFile')

    if not language or not repo_url:
        return jsonify({'passed': False, 'error': 'language and repoUrl are required'}), 400

    temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='repo-')
    try:
        # shallow clone
        subprocess.check_output(['git','clone','--depth','1', repo_url, temp_dir], stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        result = run_in_container(language, temp_dir, main_file)
        return jsonify(result), 200 if result.get('passed') or result.get('error') else 500
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        return jsonify({'passed': False, 'output': e.output.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'), 'error': 'git clone failed'}), 500
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

def get_suffix(language):
    if language.lower() == 'python':
        return '.py'
    elif language.lower() == 'javascript':
        return '.js'
    # Add other languages
    return '.txt'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', 5000)) # Gunicorn will use $PORT from Dockerfile
    # When running locally for dev: python server.py
    # For production, Gunicorn is used via the Dockerfile CMD
    if os.environ.get('FLASK_ENV') == 'development': # Simple check for local dev
        app.run(debug=True, host='0.0.0.0', port=port)
    # Gunicorn handles running the app in production (via Docker CMD)

### execution-service/docker-images/entrypoint.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generic entrypoint for Bansy language images.
# Installs production dependencies (if manifest files are present)
# then runs project tests or a supplied main file.
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace

MAIN_FILE="${1:-}"

install_deps() {
  if [[ -f package.json ]]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Installing npm packages…"
    npm ci --omit=dev || { echo "[entrypoint] npm install failed"; exit 2; }
  fi

  if [[ -f requirements.txt ]]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Installing python requirements…"
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt || true
  fi
}

run_tests_or_main() {
  if [[ -n "$MAIN_FILE" && -f "$MAIN_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Running main file $MAIN_FILE"
    case "$MAIN_FILE" in
      *.js) node "$MAIN_FILE" ;;
      *.ts) npx ts-node "$MAIN_FILE" ;;
      *.py) python "$MAIN_FILE" ;;
      *) echo "[entrypoint] Unknown file type: $MAIN_FILE"; exit 3 ;;
    esac
    return
  fi

  # Auto-detect common test commands
  if [[ -f jest.config.js || "$(jq -r '.scripts.test' package.json 2>/dev/null)" != "null" ]]; then
    npm test --silent
  elif [[ -d tests || -d test ]]; then
    if command -v pytest &>/dev/null; then
      pytest -q
    fi
  else
    echo "[entrypoint] No test target found and no MAIN_FILE supplied" >&2
    exit 4
  fi
}

install_deps
run_tests_or_main

### frontend/src/App.tsx

import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { MantineProvider, createTheme } from '@mantine/core';
import '@mantine/core/styles.css';
import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { Container, Loader, Box } from '@mantine/core';

// Lazy load heavy components to reduce initial bundle size
const Login = lazy(() => import('./pages/Login').then(module => ({ default: module.Login })));
const Register = lazy(() => import('./pages/Register').then(module => ({ default: module.Register })));
const JdDashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/JdDashboard'));
const JdCreate = lazy(() => import('./pages/JdCreate'));
const JdDetailsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/JdDetailsPage'));
const JdResumeUpload = lazy(() => import('./pages/JdResumeUpload'));
const JdEdit = lazy(() => import('./pages/JdEdit'));
const TestPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/TestPage').then(module => ({ default: module.TestPage })));
const DashboardLayout = lazy(() => import('./layouts/DashboardLayout').then(module => ({ default: module.DashboardLayout })));

// Keep ProtectedRoute non-lazy as it's needed for route protection
import { ProtectedRoute } from './components/ProtectedRoute';

const theme = createTheme({
  primaryColor: 'blue',
  defaultRadius: 'md',
});

// Loading fallback component
const LoadingFallback = () => (
  <Container style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '50px' }}>
    <Box>
      <Loader size="lg" />
    </Box>
  </Container>
);

function App() {
  return (
    <MantineProvider theme={theme} defaultColorScheme="light">
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback />}>
          <Routes>
            {/* Public routes */}
            <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
            <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />

            {/* Protected HR routes */}
            <Route
              path="/dashboard"
              element={
                <ProtectedRoute requireHR>
                  <DashboardLayout />
                </ProtectedRoute>
              }
            >
              <Route index element={<JdDashboard />} />
              <Route path="jds/new" element={<JdCreate />} />
              <Route path="jds/:id" element={<JdDetailsPage />} />
              <Route path="jds/:id/upload-resume" element={<JdResumeUpload />} />
              <Route path="jds/:id/edit" element={<JdEdit />} />
            </Route>

            {/* Candidate Test Page Route */}
            <Route path="/test/:testId" element={<TestPage />} />

            {/* Redirect root to dashboard or login */}
            <Route
              path="/"
              element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />}
            />
          </Routes>
        </Suspense>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </MantineProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

export type UserRole = 'HR' | 'CANDIDATE';

export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: UserRole;
  company?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Test {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  difficulty: string;
  gitRepoUrl?: string;
  language: string;
  requirements: Record<string, any>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  jobDescriptionId: string;
  jobDescription?: JobDescription;
  testCases?: any[];
  files?: any[];
  submissions?: Submission[];
}

export interface Submission {
  id: string;
  testId: string;
  test?: Test;

  results?: Record<string, any>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

}

}

  maxExperience: number;
  languages: string[];
  projectContext: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  creatorId: string;
  creator?: User;
  test?: Test;
  candidates?: Candidate[];
  _count?: {
    candidates: number;
  };
}

}

### frontend/src/pages/JdCreate.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, TextInput, Textarea, Button, Paper, Group, NumberInput, TagsInput } from '@mantine/core';
import { useForm } from '@mantine/form';
import { createJd } from '../services/jdService';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

const JdCreate = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const form = useForm({
    initialValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      minExperience: 0,
      maxExperience: 5,
      languages: [] as string[],
      projectContext: '',
    },
    validate: {
      title: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Title is required'),
      description: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Description is required'),
      minExperience: (value, values) => (value >= 0 && value <= values.maxExperience ? null : 'Invalid min experience'),
      maxExperience: (value) => (value > 0 ? null : 'Max experience must be positive'),
      languages: (value) => (value.length > 0 ? null : 'At least one language is required'),
      projectContext: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Project context is required'),
    },
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (values: typeof form.values) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await createJd({
        ...values,
        minExperience: Number(values.minExperience),
        maxExperience: Number(values.maxExperience),
      });

      navigate('/dashboard');
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to create JD', error);
      // You might want to show an error notification to the user here
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Container size="sm">
      <Paper withBorder shadow="md" p={30} mt={30} radius="md">
        <Title order={2} mb="lg">Create New Job Description</Title>
        <form onSubmit={form.onSubmit(handleSubmit)}>
          <TextInput
            label="Job Title"
            placeholder="e.g., Senior Frontend Developer"
            required
            {...form.getInputProps('title')}
          />
          <Textarea
            label="Job Description"
            placeholder="Describe the role, responsibilities, and what you're looking for."
            required
            mt="md"
            minRows={4}
            {...form.getInputProps('description')}
          />
          <Group grow mt="md">
            <NumberInput
              label="Min Years of Experience"
              placeholder="e.g., 0"
              required
              min={0}
              {...form.getInputProps('minExperience')}
            />
            <NumberInput
              label="Max Years of Experience"
              placeholder="e.g., 4"
              required
              min={form.values.minExperience || 0}
              {...form.getInputProps('maxExperience')}
            />
          </Group>
          <TagsInput
            label="Languages"
            placeholder="e.g., Python, React, C++ (press Enter to add)"
            required
            mt="md"
            {...form.getInputProps('languages')}
          />
          <Textarea
            label="Project Context"
            placeholder="What kind of project will the candidate work on? e.g., 'Build an ML model to detect vessels and clouds from satellite imagery.'"
            required
            mt="md"
            minRows={4}
            {...form.getInputProps('projectContext')}
          />

          <Group justify="flex-end" mt="xl">
            <Button variant="default" onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" loading={loading}>
              Create JD
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </form>
      </Paper>
    </Container>

### frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { TextInput, PasswordInput, Button, Paper, Title, Text, Container, Box } from '@mantine/core';
import { useForm } from '@mantine/form';
import { auth } from '../services/auth';
import type { LoginCredentials } from '../types';

export function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const form = useForm<LoginCredentials>({
    initialValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
    },
    validate: {
      email: (value) => (/^\S+@\S+$/.test(value) ? null : 'Invalid email'),
      password: (value) => (value.length >= 6 ? null : 'Password must be at least 6 characters'),
    },
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (values: LoginCredentials) => {
    try {
      setError('');
      await auth.login(values);
      
      // Get the page they were trying to visit or go to dashboard
      const from = location.state?.from?.pathname || '/dashboard';
      navigate(from, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError('Invalid email or password');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Container size={420} my={40}>
      <Box ta="center">
        <Title>Welcome back!</Title>
        <Text c="dimmed" size="sm" mt={5}>
          Don't have an account yet?{' '}
          <Link to="/register" style={{ color: 'var(--mantine-color-blue-6)' }}>
            Create account
          </Link>
        </Text>
      </Box>

      <Paper withBorder shadow="md" p={30} mt={30} radius="md">
        <form onSubmit={form.onSubmit(handleSubmit)}>
          <TextInput
            label="Email"
            placeholder="you@company.com"
            required
            {...form.getInputProps('email')}
          />
          <PasswordInput
            label="Password"
            placeholder="Your password"
            required
            mt="md"
            {...form.getInputProps('password')}
          />

          {error && (
            <Text c="red" size="sm" mt="sm">
              {error}
            </Text>
          )}

          <Button fullWidth mt="xl" type="submit">
            Sign in
          </Button>
        </form>
      </Paper>
    </Container>
  );
}


### frontend/src/pages/TestList.tsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Container, Grid, Button, Group, Title, Text, Loader } from '@mantine/core';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { IconPlus } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { TestCard } from '../components/TestCard';
import { getTests } from '../services/api';
import type { Test } from '../types';

export function TestList() {
  const [tests, setTests] = useState<Test[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTests = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const data = await getTests();
        setTests(data);
      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load tests. Please try again later.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTests();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Container size="lg" py="xl">
        <Group justify="center">
          <Loader />
        </Group>
      </Container>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Container size="lg" py="xl">
      <Group justify="space-between" mb="xl">
        <div>
          <Title order={2}>Coding Tests</Title>
          <Text c="dimmed" size="sm">
            Manage your coding assessments
          </Text>
        </div>
        <Button
          component={Link}
          to="/dashboard/tests/new"
          leftSection={<IconPlus size={16} />}
        >
          Create Test
        </Button>
      </Group>

      {error && (
        <Text c="red" mb="xl">
          {error}
        </Text>
      )}

      <Grid>
        {tests.map((test) => (
          <Grid.Col key={test.id} span={{ base: 12, sm: 6, lg: 4 }}>
            <TestCard test={test} />
          </Grid.Col>
        ))}

        {tests.length === 0 && !error && (
          <Grid.Col span={12}>
            <Text ta="center" c="dimmed">
              No tests found. Create your first test to get started!
            </Text>
          </Grid.Col>
        )}
      </Grid>
    </Container>
  );
}


### frontend/src/pages/JdEdit.tsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, TextInput, Textarea, Button, Paper, Group, NumberInput, TagsInput, Alert, Stack } from '@mantine/core';
import { useForm } from '@mantine/form';
import { IconAlertCircle } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { getJdById, updateJd } from '../services/jdService';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

const JdEdit = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const form = useForm({
    initialValues: {
      title: '',
      description: '',
      minExperience: 0,
      maxExperience: 5,
      languages: [] as string[],
      projectContext: '',
    },
    validate: {
      title: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Title is required'),
      description: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Description is required'),
      minExperience: (value, values) => (value >= 0 && value <= values.maxExperience ? null : 'Invalid min experience'),
      maxExperience: (value) => (value > 0 ? null : 'Max experience must be positive'),
      languages: (value) => (value.length > 0 ? null : 'At least one language is required'),
      projectContext: (value) => (value.trim().length > 0 ? null : 'Project context is required'),
    },
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) {
      setLoading(false);
      setError('Job Description ID is missing.');
      return;
    }

    const fetchJd = async () => {
      try {
        const jd = await getJdById(id);
        form.setValues({
          title: jd.title || '',
          description: jd.description || '',
          minExperience: jd.minExperience || 0,
          maxExperience: jd.maxExperience || 0,
          languages: jd.languages || [],
          projectContext: jd.projectContext || '',
        });
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Failed to fetch JD for editing', err);
        setError('Failed to load job description data.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchJd();
  }, [id]);

  const handleSubmit = async (values: typeof form.values) => {
    if (!id) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    try {
      await updateJd(id, {
        ...values,
        minExperience: Number(values.minExperience),
        maxExperience: Number(values.maxExperience),
      });
      navigate('/dashboard');
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('Failed to update JD', err);
      setError('Failed to update job description. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Container size="sm" py="xl">
      <Paper withBorder shadow="md" p={30} mt={30} radius="md">
        <Title order={2} mb="lg">
          Edit Job Description
        </Title>

        {loading && <p>Loading...</p>}

        {error && (
          <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size={16} />} title="Error" color="red" mb="lg">
            {error}
          </Alert>
        )}

        {!loading && (
          <form onSubmit={form.onSubmit(handleSubmit)}>
            <Stack gap="md">
              <TextInput
                label="Job Title"
                placeholder="e.g., Senior Frontend Developer"
                required
                {...form.getInputProps('title')}
              />
              <Textarea
                label="Job Description"
                placeholder="Describe the role, responsibilities, and what you're looking for."
                required
                minRows={4}
                {...form.getInputProps('description')}
              />
              <Group grow>
                <NumberInput
                  label="Min Years of Experience"
                  placeholder="e.g., 0"
                  required
                  min={0}
                  {...form.getInputProps('minExperience')}
                />
                <NumberInput
                  label="Max Years of Experience"
                  placeholder="e.g., 4"
                  required
                  min={form.values.minExperience || 0}
                  {...form.getInputProps('maxExperience')}
                />
              </Group>
              <TagsInput
                label="Languages"
                placeholder="e.g., Python, React, C++ (press Enter to add)"
                required
                {...form.getInputProps('languages')}
              />
              <Textarea
                label="Project Context"
                placeholder="What kind of project will the candidate work on?"
                required
                minRows={4}
                {...form.getInputProps('projectContext')}
              />

              <Group justify="flex-end" mt="xl">
                <Button variant="default" onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" loading={form.isDirty() && loading}>
                  Save Changes
                </Button>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </form>
        )}
      </Paper>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default JdEdit;
