### frontend/src/pages/JdDashboard.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, Button, Table, Group, ActionIcon, Text } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconPencil, IconTrash } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { getJds, deleteJd } from '../services/jdService';
import { JobDescription } from '../types';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

const JdDashboard = () => {
  const [jds, setJds] = useState<JobDescription[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchJds = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const data = await getJds();
        setJds(data);
        setError(null);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Failed to fetch JDs', err);
        setError('Failed to load job descriptions.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchJds();
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this job description? This action cannot be undone.')) {
      try {
        await deleteJd(id);
        setJds(jds.filter((jd) => jd.id !== id));
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Failed to delete JD', err);
        setError('Failed to delete job description.');
      }
    }
  };

  const rows = jds.map((jd) => (
    <tr key={jd.id}>
      <td>
        <Text component={Link} to={`jds/${jd.id}`} fw={500}>
          {jd.title}
        </Text>
      </td>
      <td>{jd._count?.candidates || 0}</td>
      <td>{new Date(jd.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
      <td>
        <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
          <ActionIcon component={Link} to={`jds/${jd.id}/edit`} color="blue" title="Edit JD">
            <IconPencil size={16} />
          </ActionIcon>
          <ActionIcon color="red" onClick={() => handleDelete(jd.id)} title="Delete JD">
            <IconTrash size={16} />
          </ActionIcon>
        </Group>
      </td>
    </tr>
  ));

  return (
    <Container>
      <Group justify="space-between" mb="md">
        <Title order={2}>Job Descriptions</Title>
        <Button component={Link} to="jds/new">
          Create New JD
        </Button>
      </Group>
      {loading && <Text>Loading...</Text>}
      {error && <Text color="red">{error}</Text>}
      {!loading && !error && (
        <Table striped highlightOnHover>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Title</th>
              <th>Candidates</th>
              <th>Created At</th>
              <th>Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>{rows.length > 0 ? rows : (<tr><td colSpan={4}><Text ta="center" my="md">No job descriptions found. Create one to get started.</Text></td></tr>)}</tbody>
        </Table>
      )}
    </Container>
  );
};

export default JdDashboard;


### frontend/src/pages/JdDetailsPage.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, Text, Paper, Group, Button, Card, Badge, Alert, Modal, Stack, Checkbox } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconCode, IconCheck, IconSend, IconEye } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { getJdById, generateProjectForJd, sendTestsToCandiidates } from '../services/jdService';
import { JobDescription, Test } from '../types';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

const JdDetailsPage = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [jd, setJd] = useState<JobDescription | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generatingProject, setGeneratingProject] = useState(false);
  const [projectGenerated, setProjectGenerated] = useState(false);
  const [sendingTests, setSendingTests] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCandidates, setSelectedCandidates] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [generatedProjectData, setGeneratedProjectData] = useState<{
    message: string;
    githubRepository: string;
    test: Test;
  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;

    const fetchJd = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const data = await getJdById(id);
        setJd(data);
        setError(null);
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Failed to fetch JD details', err);
        setError('Failed to load job description details.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchJd();
  }, [id]);

  const handleGenerateProject = async () => {
    if (!id) return;

    setGeneratingProject(true);
    try {
      const result = await generateProjectForJd(id);
      setGeneratedProjectData(result);
      setProjectGenerated(true);
      logger.info('Project generated successfully', result);

      // Refresh JD details to include the newly generated test
      try {
        const updatedJd = await getJdById(id);
        setJd(updatedJd);
      } catch (refreshErr) {
        logger.error('Failed to refresh JD after project generation', refreshErr);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('Failed to generate project', err);
      setError('Failed to generate project. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setGeneratingProject(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCandidateSelection = (candidateId: string, checked: boolean) => {
    const newSelection = new Set(selectedCandidates);
    if (checked) {
      newSelection.add(candidateId);
    } else {
      newSelection.delete(candidateId);
    }
    setSelectedCandidates(newSelection);
  };

  const handleSelectAll = () => {
    if (!jd?.candidates) return;
    
    const selectableCandidates = jd.candidates.filter(c => c.status !== 'TestSent');
    
    if (selectedCandidates.size === selectableCandidates.length && selectableCandidates.length > 0) {
      // Deselect all
      setSelectedCandidates(new Set());
    } else {
      // Select all selectable candidates
      setSelectedCandidates(new Set(selectableCandidates.map(c => c.id)));
    }
  };

  const handleSendTests = async () => {
    if (!jd?.test || selectedCandidates.size === 0) {
      setError('Please ensure a project is generated and candidates are selected.');
      return;
    }

    setSendingTests(true);
    try {
      const result = await sendTestsToCandiidates(jd.id, Array.from(selectedCandidates));
      
      logger.info('Tests sent successfully:', result);
      
      // Show success message with details
      alert(`${result.message}\n\nSent to:\n${result.sentTo.map(item => `• ${item.email}`).join('\n')}`);
      
      setSelectedCandidates(new Set()); // Clear selection
      
      // Refresh the JD data to show updated candidate statuses
      const refreshedJd = await getJdById(jd.id);
      setJd(refreshedJd);
      
    } catch (err) {
      logger.error('Failed to send tests', err);
      setError('Failed to send tests. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSendingTests(false);
    }
  };

  const getScoreColor = (score?: number) => {
    if (!score) return 'gray';
    if (score >= 8) return 'teal';
    if (score >= 6) return 'yellow';
    return 'red';
  };

  if (loading) return <Container><Text>Loading...</Text></Container>;
  if (error) return <Container><Text color="red">{error}</Text></Container>;
  if (!jd) return <Container><Text>Job description not found.</Text></Container>;

  const selectableCandidates = jd.candidates?.filter(c => c.status !== 'TestSent') || [];

  return (
    <Container>
      <Paper withBorder shadow="md" p={30} mt={30} radius="md">
        <Group justify="space-between" mb="lg">
          <Title order={2}>{jd.title}</Title>
          <Group>
            <Button
              leftSection={<IconCode size={16} />}
              onClick={handleGenerateProject}
              loading={generatingProject}
              color="blue"
            >
              {jd.test ? (generatingProject ? 'Regenerating...' : 'Regenerate Project') : 'Generate Project'}
            </Button>
            <Button component={Link} to={`edit`}>
              Edit JD
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Group>

        <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Created on {new Date(jd.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</Text>

        <Card withBorder radius="md" mt="xl">
          <Title order={4}>Description</Title>
          <Text mt="sm">{jd.description}</Text>
        </Card>

        <Card withBorder radius="md" mt="md">
          <Title order={4}>Key Information</Title>
          <Group mt="sm">
            <Text fw={500}>Experience:</Text>
            <Text>{jd.minExperience} - {jd.maxExperience} years</Text>
          </Group>
          <Group mt="xs">
            <Text fw={500}>Languages:</Text>
            {jd.languages.map((lang) => (
              <Badge key={lang} variant="light">{lang}</Badge>
            ))}
          </Group>
          {jd.projectContext && (
            <>
              <Title order={5} mt="md">Project Context</Title>
              <Text mt="xs" style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }}>{jd.projectContext}</Text>
            </>
          )}
        </Card>

        {jd.test && (
          <Card withBorder radius="md" mt="md">
            <Group justify="space-between">
              <Title order={4}>Generated Project</Title>
              <Group>
                <Badge color="green">Ready</Badge>
                <Button 
                  size="xs" 
                  leftSection={<IconEye size={14} />}
                  component={Link}
                  to={`/test/${jd.test.id}`}
                  variant="outline"
                  color="blue"
                >
                  View Test Page
                </Button>
              </Group>
            </Group>
            <Text mt="sm" fw={500}>{jd.test.title}</Text>
            <Text mt="xs" size="sm" c="dimmed">{jd.test.description}</Text>
            {jd.test.gitRepoUrl && (
              <Group mt="sm">
                <Text size="sm" fw={500}>Repository:</Text>
                <Text size="sm" component="a" href={jd.test.gitRepoUrl} target="_blank" style={{ color: 'blue' }}>
                  {jd.test.gitRepoUrl}
                </Text>
              </Group>
            )}
          </Card>
        )}

        <Card withBorder radius="md" mt="md">
          <Group justify="space-between" mb="md">
            <Title order={4}>Candidates ({jd.candidates?.length || 0})</Title>
            <Group>
              <Button size="xs" component={Link} to={`upload-resume`}>
                Upload Resume
              </Button>
              {selectableCandidates.length > 0 && jd.test && (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  color="green"
                  leftSection={<IconSend size={16} />}
                  onClick={handleSendTests}
                  loading={sendingTests}
                  disabled={selectedCandidates.size === 0}
                >
                  Send Test ({selectedCandidates.size})
                </Button>
              )}
            </Group>
          </Group>

          {jd.candidates && jd.candidates.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              {selectableCandidates.length > 0 && jd.test && (
                <Group mb="md">
                  <Checkbox
                    label="Select All"
                    checked={selectedCandidates.size === selectableCandidates.length && selectableCandidates.length > 0}
                    indeterminate={selectedCandidates.size > 0 && selectedCandidates.size < selectableCandidates.length}
                    onChange={handleSelectAll}
                  />
                  <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
                    ({selectableCandidates.length} candidates available for test)
                  </Text>
                </Group>
              )}
              
              {jd.candidates.map(candidate => {
                const hasBeenSentTest = candidate.status === 'TestSent';
                const canSelect = jd.test && !hasBeenSentTest;
                
                return (
                  <Paper key={candidate.id} withBorder p="sm" mt="sm" radius="sm">
                    <Group justify="space-between">
                      <Group>
                        {canSelect && (
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={selectedCandidates.has(candidate.id)}
                            onChange={(event) => handleCandidateSelection(candidate.id, event.currentTarget.checked)}
                          />
                        )}
                        <div>
                          <Text fw={500}>{candidate.resume?.email}</Text>
                          <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Applied on {new Date(candidate.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</Text>
                          {hasBeenSentTest && candidate.individualRepoUrl && (
                            <Group gap="xs" mt="xs">
                              <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Repository:</Text>
                              <Button
                                size="xs"
                                variant="subtle"
                                component="a"
                                href={candidate.individualRepoUrl}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              >
                                View GitHub Repo
                              </Button>
                              {candidate.repoCreatedAt && (
                                <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
                                  Created: {new Date(candidate.repoCreatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                                </Text>
                              )}
                            </Group>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </Group>
                      <Group>
                        <Badge color={getScoreColor(candidate.suitabilityScore)}>
                          Score: {candidate.suitabilityScore?.toFixed(1) || 'N/A'}
                        </Badge>
                        {hasBeenSentTest && (
                          <Badge color="blue" variant="light">
                            Test Sent
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {candidate.suitabilityScore && candidate.suitabilityScore < 5 && (
                          <Badge color="orange" variant="light">
                            Low Score
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {candidate.suitabilityScore && candidate.suitabilityScore >= 8 && (
                          <Badge color="teal" variant="light">
                            High Score
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </Group>
                    </Group>
                  </Paper>
                );
              })}
            </>
          ) : (
            <Text mt="sm">No candidates have applied for this job yet.</Text>
          )}
        </Card>

      </Paper>

      {/* Project Generation Success Modal */}
      <Modal 
        opened={projectGenerated} 
        onClose={() => setProjectGenerated(false)}
        title="Project Generated Successfully!"
        centered
      >
        <Stack>
          <Alert icon={<IconCheck size={16} />} title="Success" color="green">
            {generatedProjectData?.message}
          </Alert>
          
          {generatedProjectData && (
            <Card withBorder p="md">
              <Title order={5} mb="sm">Project Details</Title>
              <Text fw={500} mb="xs">{generatedProjectData.test.title}</Text>
              <Text size="sm" c="dimmed" mb="md">{generatedProjectData.test.description}</Text>
              
              <Group justify="space-between" mb="sm">
                <Text size="sm" fw={500}>GitHub Repository:</Text>
                <Button 
                  size="xs" 
                  variant="outline" 
                  component="a" 
                  href={generatedProjectData.githubRepository} 
                  target="_blank"
                >
                  View Repository
                </Button>
              </Group>
              
              <Group justify="space-between">
                <Text size="sm" fw={500}>Test Page:</Text>
                <Button 
                  size="xs" 
                  leftSection={<IconEye size={14} />}
                  component={Link}
                  to={`/test/${generatedProjectData.test.id}`}
                  variant="filled"
                  color="blue"
                >
                  View Test Page
                </Button>
              </Group>
            </Card>
          )}
          
          <Button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>
            Refresh Page
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      </Modal>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default JdDetailsPage;


### frontend/src/pages/JdResumeUpload.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  Container,
  Title,
  Text,
  Paper,
  Button,
  FileInput,
  TextInput,
  Stack,
  Alert,
  Group,
  Badge,
  Card,
} from '@mantine/core';
import { useForm } from '@mantine/form';
import { IconUpload, IconAlertCircle, IconCheck } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { uploadResumeForJd } from './../services/resumeService';
import { logger } from './../utils/logger';

interface ResumeFormData {
  email: string;
  file: File | null;
}

interface AnalysisResult {
  suitabilityScore: number;
  summary: string;
}

const JdResumeUpload = () => {
  const { id: jdId } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  const [analysisResult, setAnalysisResult] = useState<AnalysisResult | null>(null);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const form = useForm<ResumeFormData>({
    initialValues: {
      email: '',
      file: null,
    },
    validate: {
      email: (value) => (/^\S+@\S+$/.test(value) ? null : 'Invalid email'),
      file: (value) => {
        console.log('File validation - value:', value);
        return (!value ? 'Resume file is required' : null);
      },
    },
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (values: ResumeFormData) => {
    console.log('Form submission - values:', values);
    console.log('File object:', values.file);
    console.log('Selected file state:', selectedFile);
    
    const fileToUpload = values.file || selectedFile;
    
    if (!fileToUpload || !jdId) {
      console.log('Missing file or jdId:', { formFile: values.file, selectedFile, jdId });
      setError('Please select a file and ensure JD ID is present.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
    setAnalysisResult(null);

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('email', values.email);
    formData.append('file', fileToUpload);

    const fileEntry = formData.get('file');
    console.log('FormData created:', {
      email: formData.get('email'),
      file: fileEntry,
      fileType: fileEntry?.constructor.name,
      fileSize: (fileEntry as File)?.size,
      fileName: (fileEntry as File)?.name,
    });

    try {
      const response = await uploadResumeForJd(jdId, formData);
      setSuccess('Resume uploaded and analyzed successfully!');
      
      // Extract analysis results from response
      if (response.analysis) {
        setAnalysisResult({
          suitabilityScore: response.analysis.suitabilityScore,
          summary: response.analysis.summary,
        });
      }

      form.reset();
      setSelectedFile(null);
      
      // Navigate back after showing results for a few seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate(`/dashboard/jds/${jdId}`);
      }, 4000);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      logger.error('Failed to upload resume for JD', err);
      // Check for a detailed error message from the backend
      const error = err as { response?: { data?: { error?: string; details?: string } } };
      if (error.response && error.response.data && error.response.data.error) {
        let errorMessage = error.response.data.error;
        if (error.response.data.details) {
          errorMessage += `: ${error.response.data.details}`;
        }
        setError(errorMessage);
      } else {
        setError('Failed to upload resume. An unexpected error occurred.');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 8) return 'teal';
    if (score >= 6) return 'yellow';
    return 'red';
  };

  return (
    <Container size="md" py="xl">
      <Title order={2} mb="sm">
        Upload Resume for Job Description
      </Title>
      <Text c="dimmed" mb="xl">
        Upload a candidate's resume to evaluate it against this specific job description.
      </Text>

      <Paper withBorder radius="md" p="xl">
        <form onSubmit={form.onSubmit(handleSubmit)}>
          <Stack gap="md">
            <TextInput
              required
              label="Candidate Email"
              placeholder="candidate@company.com"
              {...form.getInputProps('email')}
            />

            <FileInput
              required
              label="Resume"
              placeholder="Upload resume (PDF, DOC, DOCX)"
              accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx"
              leftSection={<IconUpload size={14} />}
              value={selectedFile}
              onChange={(file) => {
                console.log('File selected:', file);
                setSelectedFile(file);
                form.setFieldValue('file', file);
              }}
              error={!selectedFile && form.errors.file}
            />

            {error && (
              <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size={16} />} title="Error" color="red">
                {error}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {success && (
              <Alert icon={<IconCheck size={16} />} title="Success" color="green">
                {success}
              </Alert>
            )}

            {analysisResult && (
              <Card withBorder p="md" radius="md">
                <Title order={4} mb="sm">AI Analysis Results</Title>
                <Group justify="space-between" mb="xs">
                  <Text fw={500}>Suitability Score:</Text>
                  <Badge size="lg" color={getScoreColor(analysisResult.suitabilityScore)}>
                    {analysisResult.suitabilityScore.toFixed(1)}/10
                  </Badge>
                </Group>
                <Text size="sm" c="dimmed" mb="sm">Summary:</Text>
                <Text size="sm">{analysisResult.summary}</Text>
              </Card>
            )}

            <Group justify="flex-end" mt="md">
              <Button variant="default" onClick={() => navigate(`/dashboard/jds/${jdId}`)}>
                Back to JD
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" loading={loading}>
                Upload & Analyze Resume
              </Button>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        </form>
      </Paper>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default JdResumeUpload;


### frontend/src/pages/TestPage/TestPage.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, Paper, Alert, LoadingOverlay, Text, Badge, Group, Button } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconAlertCircle, IconPlayerPlay, IconUpload } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { testService, Test } from '../../services/testService';

interface SubmissionState {
  submissionId: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'success' | 'failure';
  ciCdScore?: number;
  llmScore?: number;
  results?: Array<{
    testCase: number;
    passed: boolean;
    output?: string;
    error?: string;
  }>;
}

export function TestPage() {
  const { testId } = useParams<{ testId: string }>();
  const [test, setTest] = useState<Test | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [testRunning, setTestRunning] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submission, setSubmission] = useState<SubmissionState | null>(null);


  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTest = async () => {
      try {
        if (!testId) return;
        setLoading(true);
        
        const data = await testService.getTest(testId);
        console.log('Fetched test data in TestPage:', data);
        setTest(data);

      } catch (err) {
        setError('Failed to load test data. Please try again.');
        console.error('Error in fetchTest:', err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTest();
  }, [testId]);

  // Poll submission when pending
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!submission || submission.status !== 'pending') return;

    const id = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const latest = await testService.getSubmission(submission.submissionId);
        if (latest.status !== 'pending') {
          setSubmission({
            submissionId: latest.id ?? '',
            status: latest.status as any,
            ciCdScore: latest.ciCdScore,
            llmScore: latest.llmScore,
            results: latest.results,
          });
          clearInterval(id);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Polling submission failed', e);
      }
    }, 15000);

    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [submission]);


  // Function to handle running tests
  const handleRunTests = async () => {
    if (!testId) {
      setError('Test ID is missing');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setTestRunning(true);
      setError(null);

      // Run the tests using the GitHub repository
      const results = await testService.runTests(testId);
      setSubmission({
        submissionId: 'local',
        status: results.status as any,
        results: results.results,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error('Error running tests:', err);
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
      setError(`Failed to run tests: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setTestRunning(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle final submission
  const handleSubmitSolution = async () => {
    if (!testId) {
      setError('Test ID is missing');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);
      setError(null);
      const res = await testService.submitSolution(testId, {});
      setSubmission({
        submissionId: res.submissionId ?? '',
        status: res.status,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error('Error submitting solution:', err);
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
      setError(`Failed to submit solution: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!test) {
    return null; // Or loading spinner
  }

  return (
    <Container size="xl" py="xl" pos="relative">
      <LoadingOverlay visible={loading} zIndex={1000} overlayProps={{ blur: 2 }} />
      
      {error && (
        <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size={16} />} color="red" mb="lg">
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      {submission && (
        <Alert 
          color={submission.status === 'success' ? 'green' : submission.status === 'pending' ? 'blue' : 'yellow'}
          mb="lg"
        >
          <Title order={4} mb="xs">
            {submission.status === 'pending' && 'Tests are running…'}
            {submission.status === 'success' && 'All Tests Passed!'}
            {submission.status === 'failure' && 'Some Tests Failed'}
          </Title>
          {submission.status === 'pending' && (
            <Text size="sm">Please wait while CI/CD completes. Refresh this page in a minute.</Text>
          )}
          {Array.isArray(submission.results) && submission.results.length > 0 && (
            submission.results.map((result, index) => (
              <Paper key={index} withBorder p="xs" mb="xs">
                <Group justify="space-between">
                  <Text>Test Case {result.testCase + 1}</Text>
                  <Badge color={result.passed ? 'green' : 'red'}>
                    {result.passed ? 'PASSED' : 'FAILED'}
                  </Badge>
                </Group>
                {!result.passed && result.error && (
                  <Text c="red" size="sm" mt="xs">{result.error}</Text>
                )}
                {result.output && (
                  <Text size="sm" mt="xs" style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                    Output: {result.output}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </Paper>
            ))
          )}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Paper withBorder p="md" mb="lg">
        <Group justify="space-between" mb="md">
          <Title order={2}>{test.title}</Title>
          <Group>
            <Button
              leftSection={<IconUpload size={18} />}
              color="blue"
              onClick={handleSubmitSolution}
              loading={submitting}
              disabled={!test.gitRepoUrl}
            >
              Submit Solution
            </Button>
          <Button
            leftSection={<IconPlayerPlay size={18} />}
            color="green"
            onClick={handleRunTests}
            loading={testRunning}
            disabled={!test.gitRepoUrl}
          >
            Run Tests
          </Button>
          </Group>
        </Group>
        <Text mb="lg">{test.description}</Text>

        <Title order={4} mb="xs">Requirements</Title>
        <ul>
          {test.requirements?.requirements?.map((req, index) => (
            <li key={index}><Text>{req}</Text></li>
          )) || <Text color="dimmed">No requirements specified</Text>}
        </ul>

        {test.gitRepoUrl ? (
          <>
            <Title order={4} mt="lg" mb="xs">Git Repository</Title>
            <Paper withBorder p="md" mb="lg" style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa' }}>
              <Group justify="space-between" mb="xs">
                <Text fw={500}>Clone this repository to get started:</Text>
                <Badge color="blue">Git</Badge>
              </Group>
              <Text component="pre" style={{ backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5', padding: '10px', borderRadius: '4px', margin: 0 }}>
                git clone {test.gitRepoUrl}
              </Text>
            </Paper>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size="1rem" />} color="yellow" mt="lg">
            Git repository is being created. Please refresh the page in a few moments.
          </Alert>
        )}

        <Title order={4} mt="lg" mb="xs">Test Cases</Title>
        {test.testCases.map((testCase, index) => (
          <Paper key={index} withBorder p="sm" mb="xs">
            <Text fw={500}>Test {index + 1}: {testCase.description}</Text>
            {testCase.input && (
              <Text size="sm" mt="xs">Input: {testCase.input}</Text>
            )}
            <Text size="sm" mt="xs">Expected Output: {testCase.expectedOutput}</Text>
          </Paper>
        ))}
      </Paper>


    </Container>
  );
}

  }

### frontend/src/services/auth.ts

import { login as apiLogin, register as apiRegister } from './api';
import type { LoginCredentials, RegisterData, User } from '../types';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

export class AuthService {
  private static instance: AuthService;
  private user: User | null = null;
  private token: string | null = null;

  private constructor() {
    // Load user and token from localStorage on initialization
    const storedUser = localStorage.getItem('user');
    const storedToken = localStorage.getItem('token');
    
    if (storedUser && storedToken) {
      try {
        this.user = JSON.parse(storedUser);
        this.token = storedToken;
        logger.info('User session restored', { userId: this.user?.id });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Failed to parse stored user data', error);
        this.clearSession();
      }
    } else {
      logger.debug('No stored session found');
    }
  }

  public static getInstance(): AuthService {
    if (!AuthService.instance) {
      AuthService.instance = new AuthService();
      logger.debug('AuthService instance created');
    }
    return AuthService.instance;
  }

  public async validateToken(): Promise<boolean> {
    // Add a 5-second timeout so that the UI is not stuck in a "Validating session…" state
    // if the backend is down or taking too long to respond.  We prefer the shared
    // Axios instance (which already injects baseURL & auth headers) but also guard
    // against environments where `api` might not be initialised by falling back to
    // the previous `fetch` implementation.

    const TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
    if (!this.token) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      // Dynamically import the shared axios instance only when needed to avoid a
      // circular dependency with `api` importing `auth`.
      const { api } = await import('./api');

      const controller = new AbortController();
      const id = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), TIMEOUT_MS);

      await api.get('/auth/validate', {
        signal: controller.signal,
        timeout: TIMEOUT_MS,
      });
      clearTimeout(id);

      logger.debug('Token validation successful');
      return true;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const err = error as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (err.name === 'AbortError' || err.code === 'ECONNABORTED') {
        logger.error('Token validation timed out');
      } else {
        logger.error('Token validation error', error);
      }

      this.clearSession();
      return false;
    }
  }

  public async login(credentials: LoginCredentials): Promise<User> {
    logger.info('Processing login');
    try {
      const { user, token } = await apiLogin(credentials);
      this.setSession(user, token);
      logger.info('Login successful, session established', { userId: user.id });
      return user;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Login process failed', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  public async register(data: RegisterData): Promise<User> {
    logger.info('Processing registration');
    try {
      const { user, token } = await apiRegister(data);
      this.setSession(user, token);
      logger.info('Registration successful, session established', { userId: user.id });
      return user;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Registration process failed', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  public logout(): void {
    logger.info('Logging out user', { userId: this.user?.id });
    this.clearSession();
    logger.info('User logged out, session cleared');
  }

  public getUser(): User | null {
    return this.user;
  }

  public isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    const isAuth = !!this.token && !!this.user;
    logger.debug('Checking authentication status', { 
      isAuthenticated: isAuth,
      userId: this.user?.id 
    });
    return isAuth;
  }

  public isHR(): boolean {
    const isHR = this.user?.role === 'HR';
    logger.debug('Checking HR status', { 
      isHR,
      userId: this.user?.id,
      role: this.user?.role 
    });
    return isHR;
  }

  private setSession(user: User, token: string): void {
    logger.debug('Setting up user session', { userId: user.id });
    localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(user));
    localStorage.setItem('token', token);
    this.user = user;
    this.token = token;
    logger.info('User session established', { userId: user.id });
  }

  private clearSession(): void {
    localStorage.removeItem('user');
    localStorage.removeItem('token');
    this.user = null;
    this.token = null;
  }
}

export const auth = AuthService.getInstance();

import axios from 'axios';

export interface Test {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  difficulty: string;
  language: string;
  requirements: { requirements: string[] };
  gitRepoUrl?: string;
  testCases: Array<{
    input: string | null;
    expectedOutput: string;
    description: string;
  }>;
}

interface SubmissionResult {
  submissionId?: string;
  id?: string;
  status: 'success' | 'failure' | 'pending';
  results?: Array<{
    testCase: number;
    passed: boolean;
    output?: string;
    error?: string;
  }>;
  llmScore?: number;
  ciCdScore?: number;
}

type SubmissionDetails = SubmissionResult & {
  llmEvaluation?: unknown;
};

export const testService = {
  // Fetch a specific test by ID
  async getTest(testId: string): Promise<Test> {
    const response = await axios.get(`/api/tests/${testId}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // Submit a solution for testing
  async submitSolution(testId: string, files: Record<string, string>): Promise<SubmissionResult> {
    const response = await axios.post(`/api/tests/${testId}/submit`, { files });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Run tests using the GitHub repository code
  async runTests(testId: string): Promise<SubmissionResult> {
    const response = await axios.post(`/api/tests/${testId}/run`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // Fetch a submission by ID (CI + LLM results)
  async getSubmission(submissionId: string): Promise<SubmissionDetails> {
    const response = await axios.get(`/api/submissions/${submissionId}`);
    return response.data;
  }
};

### frontend/src/services/api.ts

import axios from 'axios';
import type { LoginCredentials, RegisterData, User, Test, Submission } from '../types';
import { logger } from '../utils/logger';

// Resolve the base API URL. If the environment variable already includes the
// `/api` segment we use it as-is, otherwise we append it so that relative paths
// like `/jds` correctly resolve to `/api/jds` on the backend.  If the env var is
// not provided we fall back to `window.location.origin`, which automatically
// matches the current protocol (http vs https) and host, eliminating cross-
// scheme issues that cause long connection delays when the page is served over
// HTTPS but the API URL points to plain HTTP.

const fallbackOrigin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'http://localhost:3001';
const rawBaseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL as string | undefined) || fallbackOrigin;

const baseURL = rawBaseUrl.endsWith('/api') ? rawBaseUrl : `${rawBaseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/api`;

export const api = axios.create({
  baseURL,
  timeout: 15000, // Abort requests after 15 s so the UI can show an error instead of hanging
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
});

// Add auth token to requests if available
api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  logger.debug('API Request', { 
    method: config.method?.toUpperCase(),
    url: config.url,
    headers: config.headers
  });
  return config;
});

// Add response logging and handle auth errors
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => {
    logger.debug('API Response', {
      status: response.status,
      url: response.config.url,
      data: response.data
    });
    return response;
  },
  (error) => {
    logger.error('API Error', {
      status: error.response?.status,
      url: error.config?.url,
      message: error.message,
      response: error.response?.data
    });

    // Handle authentication errors
    if (error.response?.status === 401 || error.response?.status === 403) {
      logger.warn('Authentication error detected, clearing session');
      // Clear invalid session data
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      
      // Redirect to login page if not already there
      if (!window.location.pathname.includes('/login') && !window.location.pathname.includes('/register')) {
        window.location.href = '/login';
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

### frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx

import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Container, Title, Text, Loader, Box } from '@mantine/core';
import { auth } from '../services/auth';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  requireHR?: boolean;
}

// Cache validation result for 5 minutes to avoid repeated API calls
let validationCache = {
  isValid: false,
  timestamp: 0,
  CACHE_DURATION: 5 * 60 * 1000 // 5 minutes
};

export const ProtectedRoute = ({ children, requireHR = false }: ProtectedRouteProps) => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = useState(true);
  const [isValid, setIsValid] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const validateSession = async () => {
      // Quick local check first
      if (!auth.isAuthenticated()) {
        setIsValidating(false);
        setIsValid(false);
        return;
      }

      // Check cache first to avoid repeated API calls
      const now = Date.now();
      if (validationCache.timestamp + validationCache.CACHE_DURATION > now) {
        setIsValid(validationCache.isValid);
        setIsValidating(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Validate the token with the backend only if cache is expired
        const tokenIsValid = await auth.validateToken();
        
        // Update cache
        validationCache = {
          isValid: tokenIsValid,
          timestamp: now,
          CACHE_DURATION: validationCache.CACHE_DURATION
        };
        
        setIsValid(tokenIsValid);
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Token validation failed:', error);
        setIsValid(false);
        validationCache.isValid = false;
      } finally {
        setIsValidating(false);
      }
    };

    validateSession();
  }, []);

  // Show loading spinner while validating
  if (isValidating) {
    return (
      <Container style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '50px' }}>
        <Box>
          <Loader size="lg" />
          <Text mt="md" c="dimmed">Validating session...</Text>
        </Box>
      </Container>
    );
  }

  // Redirect to login if not authenticated or token is invalid
  if (!isValid) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  if (requireHR && !auth.isHR()) {
    // Show an unauthorized message instead of redirecting to prevent loops
    return (
      <Container style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '50px' }}>
        <Title order={2}>Unauthorized Access</Title>
        <Text c="dimmed">You do not have the required permissions to view this page.</Text>
      </Container>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
};


### frontend/src/components/AssessmentTrackingDashboard.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Container,
  Title,
  Grid,
  Card,
  Text,
  Badge,
  Progress,
  Timeline,
  Group,
  Stack,
  Center,
  Loader,
  Alert,
  ActionIcon,
  Tooltip,
  Table,
  ScrollArea,
  RingProgress,
} from '@mantine/core';
import { 
  IconRefresh, 
  IconActivity, 
  IconEye,
  IconCode,
  IconGitBranch,
  IconGitCommit
} from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { assessmentTracking } from '../services/api';

interface AssessmentTrackingProps {
  jdId: string;
}

interface TrackingData {
  overview: {
    totalCandidates: number;
    testsSent: number;
    inProgress: number;
    completed: number;
    avgSuitabilityScore: number;
  };
  candidates: Array<{
    id: string;
    email: string;
    status: string;
    suitabilityScore: number;
    progressPercentage: number;
    activity: {
      totalEvents: number;
      pushEvents: number;
      workflowEvents: number;
      lastActivityAt: string;
      timeElapsed: number | null;
    };
    timeline: Array<{
      type: string;
      timestamp: string;
      details: {
        repoName: string;
        branch: string;
        pusher: string;
      };
    }>;
  }>;
  recentActivity: Array<{
    type: string;
    timestamp: string;
    candidate: {
      id: string;
      email: string;
    } | null;
    details: {
      repoName: string;
      branch: string;
      pusher: string;
      commitSha: string;
    };
  }>;
}

const AssessmentTrackingDashboard: React.FC<AssessmentTrackingProps> = ({ jdId }) => {
  const [trackingData, setTrackingData] = useState<TrackingData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  const fetchTrackingData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await assessmentTracking.getTrackingData(jdId);
      setTrackingData(data);
      setLastUpdated(new Date());
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching tracking data:', err);
      setError('Failed to fetch assessment tracking data');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTrackingData();
  }, [jdId]);

  // Auto-refresh every 30 seconds
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetchTrackingData();
    }, 30000); // 30 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [jdId]);

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'TestSent': return 'blue';
      case 'InProgress': return 'yellow';
      case 'Completed': return 'green';
      default: return 'gray';
    }
  };

  const getEventIcon = (eventType: string) => {
    if (eventType === 'push') return <IconGitCommit size={16} />;
    if (eventType.startsWith('workflow_')) return <IconCode size={16} />;
    if (eventType.startsWith('issue_')) return <IconActivity size={16} />;
    return <IconGitBranch size={16} />;
  };

  const formatTimeElapsed = (milliseconds: number | null) => {
    if (!milliseconds) return 'N/A';
    
    const hours = Math.floor(milliseconds / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const minutes = Math.floor((milliseconds % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    
    if (hours > 24) {
      const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
      return `${days}d ${hours % 24}h ago`;
    } else if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}h ${minutes}m ago`;
    } else {
      return `${minutes}m ago`;
    }
  };

  if (loading && !trackingData) {
    return (
      <Container>
        <Center style={{ height: 400 }}>
          <Stack align="center" gap="md">
            <Loader size="lg" />
            <Text>Loading assessment tracking data...</Text>
          </Stack>
        </Center>
      </Container>
    );
  }

  if (error && !trackingData) {
    return (
      <Container>
        <Alert color="red" title="Error">
          {error}
        </Alert>
      </Container>
    );
  }

  if (!trackingData) return null;

  return (
    <Container size="xl">
      <Group justify="space-between" mb="lg">
        <Title order={2}>Assessment Tracking Dashboard</Title>
        <Group>
          <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
            Last updated: {lastUpdated?.toLocaleTimeString() || 'Never'}
          </Text>
          <Tooltip label="Refresh data">
            <ActionIcon 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={fetchTrackingData}
              loading={loading}
            >
              <IconRefresh size={16} />
            </ActionIcon>
          </Tooltip>
        </Group>
      </Group>

      {/* Overview Cards */}
      <Grid mb="xl">
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 3 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Text size="xs" tt="uppercase" c="dimmed" fw={700}>
              Total Candidates
            </Text>
            <Text fw={700} size="xl">
              {trackingData.overview.totalCandidates}
            </Text>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 3 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Text size="xs" tt="uppercase" c="dimmed" fw={700}>
              Tests Sent
            </Text>
            <Text fw={700} size="xl" c="blue">
              {trackingData.overview.testsSent}
            </Text>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 3 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Text size="xs" tt="uppercase" c="dimmed" fw={700}>
              In Progress
            </Text>
            <Text fw={700} size="xl" c="yellow">
              {trackingData.overview.inProgress}
            </Text>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, md: 3 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Text size="xs" tt="uppercase" c="dimmed" fw={700}>
              Completed
            </Text>
            <Text fw={700} size="xl" c="green">
              {trackingData.overview.completed}
            </Text>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>
      </Grid>

      <Grid>
        {/* Candidate Progress Table */}
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, lg: 8 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Title order={3} mb="md">Candidate Progress</Title>
            <ScrollArea style={{ height: 400 }}>
              <Table striped highlightOnHover>
                <Table.Thead>
                  <Table.Tr>
                    <Table.Th>Candidate</Table.Th>
                    <Table.Th>Status</Table.Th>
                    <Table.Th>Progress</Table.Th>
                    <Table.Th>Activity</Table.Th>
                    <Table.Th>Last Seen</Table.Th>
                    <Table.Th>Actions</Table.Th>
                  </Table.Tr>
                </Table.Thead>
                <Table.Tbody>
                  {trackingData.candidates.map((candidate) => (
                    <Table.Tr key={candidate.id}>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Stack gap={2}>
                          <Text fw={500}>{candidate.email}</Text>
                          <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
                            Score: {candidate.suitabilityScore?.toFixed(1) || 'N/A'}
                          </Text>
                        </Stack>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Badge color={getStatusColor(candidate.status)} variant="light">
                          {candidate.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Stack gap={4}>
                          <Progress 
                            value={candidate.progressPercentage} 
                            size="sm" 
                            color={getStatusColor(candidate.status)}
                          />
                          <Text size="xs">{candidate.progressPercentage}%</Text>
                        </Stack>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Group gap={8}>
                          <Tooltip label="Total Events">
                            <Badge variant="outline" size="xs">
                              {candidate.activity.totalEvents}
                            </Badge>
                          </Tooltip>
                          <Tooltip label="Code Pushes">
                            <Badge variant="outline" size="xs" color="blue">
                              {candidate.activity.pushEvents} pushes
                            </Badge>
                          </Tooltip>
                        </Group>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Text size="sm">
                          {formatTimeElapsed(candidate.activity.timeElapsed)}
                        </Text>
                      </Table.Td>
                      <Table.Td>
                        <Tooltip label="View Details">
                          <ActionIcon 
                            variant="outline" 
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => {
                              // TODO: Open candidate details modal
                              console.log('View candidate details:', candidate.id);
                            }}
                          >
                            <IconEye size={14} />
                          </ActionIcon>
                        </Tooltip>
                      </Table.Td>
                    </Table.Tr>
                  ))}
                </Table.Tbody>
              </Table>
            </ScrollArea>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>

        {/* Recent Activity Timeline */}
        <Grid.Col span={{ base: 12, lg: 4 }}>
          <Card withBorder padding="md">
            <Title order={3} mb="md">Recent Activity</Title>
            <ScrollArea style={{ height: 400 }}>
              <Timeline>
                {trackingData.recentActivity.map((activity, index) => (
                  <Timeline.Item
                    key={index}
                    bullet={getEventIcon(activity.type)}
                    title={activity.type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}
                  >
                    <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">
                      {activity.candidate?.email || 'System'}
                    </Text>
                    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">
                      {activity.details.branch} • {activity.details.commitSha}
                    </Text>
                    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">

                ))}
              </Timeline>
            </ScrollArea>
          </Card>
        </Grid.Col>
      </Grid>

      {/* Assessment Progress Overview */}
      <Card withBorder padding="md" mt="xl">
        <Title order={3} mb="md">Assessment Progress Overview</Title>
        <Group justify="center">
          <RingProgress
            size={120}
            thickness={12}
            sections={[
              { value: (trackingData.overview.completed / trackingData.overview.totalCandidates) * 100, color: 'green' },
              { value: (trackingData.overview.inProgress / trackingData.overview.totalCandidates) * 100, color: 'yellow' },

            <Group gap={8}>
              <Badge color="blue" variant="light">Test Sent</Badge>
              <Text size="sm">{trackingData.overview.testsSent - trackingData.overview.inProgress - trackingData.overview.completed} candidates</Text>

  );
};

export default AssessmentTrackingDashboard; 

### frontend/src/components/TestEditor/TestEditor.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Box, Button, Group, Paper, Tabs, Alert, Text, Code, Badge, ActionIcon, Tooltip } from '@mantine/core';
import { IconCode, IconTestPipe, IconPlayerPlay, IconAlertCircle, IconDownload, IconCopy, IconUpload } from '@tabler/icons-react';
import { testService } from '../../services/testService';

interface TestCase {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  input?: string;
  expectedOutput: string;
}

interface TestFile {
  id: string;
  path: string;
  content: string;
}

interface TestEditorProps {
  testCases: TestCase[];
  testId?: string;
  code?: string;
  files?: TestFile[];
}

export function TestEditor({
  testCases = [],
  testId,
  code = ''
}: TestEditorProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('code');
  const [runningTests, setRunningTests] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState<{
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
    results?: {
      passed: number;
      failed: number;
      tests: Array<{
        name: string;
        passed: boolean;
        output: string;
      }>;
    };
  } | null>(null);
  // NEW STATE FOR SUBMITTING
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Handle code copy
  const handleCopyCode = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to copy code:', err);
    }
  };

  // Handle file download
  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!testId) {
      return;
    }

    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/tests/${testId}/download`, {
        method: 'GET'
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Download failed with status ${response.status}`);
      }

      const blob = await response.blob();
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `test-${testId}-files.zip`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading files:', error);
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };
  
  // Handle running tests
  const runTests = async () => {
    if (!testId) {
      setTestResults({
        success: false,
        error: 'No test ID provided'
      });
      return;
    }
    
    setRunningTests(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/tests/${testId}/run`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        }
      });
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`API returned status ${response.status}`);
      }
      
      const data = await response.json();
      setTestResults({
        success: true,
        results: {
          passed: data.results.filter((r: { passed: boolean }) => r.passed).length,
          failed: data.results.filter((r: { passed: boolean }) => !r.passed).length,
          tests: data.results.map((r: { passed: boolean; output: string }, i: number) => ({
            name: testCases[i]?.description || `Test ${i + 1}`,
            passed: r.passed,
            output: r.output
          }))
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error running tests:', error);
      setTestResults({
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to run tests'
      });
    } finally {
      setRunningTests(false);
      setActiveTab('results');
    }
  };
  
  // NEW: Handle final submission (uses latest commit on GitHub)
  const submitSolution = async () => {
    if (!testId) {
      setTestResults({ success: false, error: 'No test ID provided' });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const result = await testService.submitSolution(testId, {});
      setTestResults({
        success: result.status === 'success',
        results: {
          passed: result.results?.filter(r => r.passed).length ?? 0,
          failed: result.results?.filter(r => !r.passed).length ?? 0,
          tests: (result.results ?? []).map((r, i) => ({
            name: testCases[i]?.description || `Test ${i + 1}`,
            passed: r.passed,
            output: r.output || r.error || ''
          }))
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error submitting solution:', error);
      setTestResults({
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit solution'
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
      setActiveTab('results');
    }
  };
  
  return (
    <Box>
      <Group justify="space-between" mb="md">
        <Group>
          <Button
            variant="light"
            leftSection={<IconDownload size={16} />}
            onClick={handleDownload}
            loading={downloading}
          >
            Download Files
          </Button>
        </Group>
        <Group>
          <Button
            leftSection={<IconUpload size={16} />}
            color="blue"
            onClick={submitSolution}
            loading={submitting}
          >
            Submit Solution
          </Button>
        <Button
          leftSection={<IconPlayerPlay size={16} />}
          color="green"
          onClick={runTests}
          loading={runningTests}
        >
          Run Tests
        </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      
      <Tabs value={activeTab} onChange={(value) => value && setActiveTab(value)}>
        <Tabs.List>
          <Tabs.Tab value="code" leftSection={<IconCode size={14} />}>Code</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="tests" leftSection={<IconTestPipe size={14} />}>Tests</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="results" leftSection={<IconTestPipe size={14} />}>Results</Tabs.Tab>
        </Tabs.List>

        <Tabs.Panel value="code">
          <Paper withBorder p="md" style={{ height: '70vh', overflow: 'auto' }}>
            <Group justify="space-between" mb="xs">
              <Text size="sm" fw={500}>main.py</Text>
              <Tooltip label="Copy code">
                <ActionIcon variant="subtle" onClick={handleCopyCode}>
                  <IconCopy size={16} />
                </ActionIcon>
              </Tooltip>
            </Group>
            <Code block style={{ height: 'calc(100% - 40px)', backgroundColor: '#1e1e1e', color: '#d4d4d4' }}>
              {code}
            </Code>
          </Paper>
        </Tabs.Panel>

        <Tabs.Panel value="tests">
          <Paper withBorder p="md" style={{ height: '70vh', overflow: 'auto' }}>
            {testCases.map((test, index) => (
              <Paper key={test.id} withBorder p="md" mb="md">
                <Text fw={500} mb="xs">Test Case {index + 1}</Text>
                <Text size="sm" c="dimmed" mb="xs">{test.description}</Text>
                
                {test.input && (
                  <Box mb="xs">
                    <Text size="sm" fw={500}>Input:</Text>
                    <Code block>{test.input}</Code>
                  </Box>
                )}
                
                <Text size="sm" fw={500}>Expected Output:</Text>
                <Code block>{test.expectedOutput}</Code>
              </Paper>
            ))}
          </Paper>
        </Tabs.Panel>

        <Tabs.Panel value="results">
          <Paper withBorder p="md" style={{ height: '70vh', overflow: 'auto' }}>
            {testResults ? (
              testResults.error ? (
                <Alert icon={<IconAlertCircle size={16} />} title="Error" color="red">
                  {testResults.error}
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Group mb="md">
                    <Text>
                      Passed: <Text span c="green" fw={500}>{testResults.results?.passed || 0}</Text>
                    </Text>
                    <Text>
                      Failed: <Text span c="red" fw={500}>{testResults.results?.failed || 0}</Text>
                    </Text>
                  </Group>
                  
                  {testResults.results?.tests.map((result, index) => (
                    <Paper key={index} withBorder p="md" mb="md">
                      <Group mb="xs">
                        <Text fw={500}>{result.name}</Text>
                        <Badge color={result.passed ? 'green' : 'red'}>
                          {result.passed ? 'PASSED' : 'FAILED'}
                        </Badge>
                      </Group>
                      <Code block>{result.output}</Code>
                    </Paper>
                  ))}
                </>
              )
            ) : (
              <Text c="dimmed" ta="center">Run tests to see results</Text>
            )}
          </Paper>
        </Tabs.Panel>
      </Tabs>
    </Box>
  );
}

### frontend/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx

import { Outlet, Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

### frontend/src/utils/logger.ts

type LogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';

class Logger {
  private static instance: Logger;
  private isDevelopment: boolean;

  private constructor() {
    this.isDevelopment = import.meta.env.MODE === 'development';
  }

  public static getInstance(): Logger {
    if (!Logger.instance) {
      Logger.instance = new Logger();
    }
    return Logger.instance;
  }

  private formatMessage(level: LogLevel, message: string, data?: any): string {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    return `[${timestamp}] [${level.toUpperCase()}] ${message}${data ? '\n' + JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) : ''}`;
  }

  public debug(message: string, data?: any): void {
    if (this.isDevelopment) {
      console.debug(this.formatMessage('debug', message, data));
    }
  }

  public info(message: string, data?: any): void {
    console.info(this.formatMessage('info', message, data));
  }

  public warn(message: string, data?: any): void {
    console.warn(this.formatMessage('warn', message, data));
  }

  public error(message: string, error?: any): void {
    console.error(this.formatMessage('error', message, error));
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(error.stack);
    }
  }
}

export const logger = Logger.getInstance();
